| `Group.setMemberRequiredPower` | wasm-dpp2: set one member's power (also setMembers, setRequiredPower) | `P:wasm-dpp2/src/tokens/configuration/group.rs` | — |
| `DistributionFunction.Linear` | wasm-dpp2: static constructors FixedAmountDistribution, Random, StepDecreasingAmount, Stepwise, Linear, Polynomial, Exponential, Logarithmic, InvertedLogarithmic | `P:wasm-dpp2/src/tokens/configuration/distribution_function.rs` | — |
| `TokenPaymentInfo.setMaximumTokenCost` | wasm-dpp2: set token payment limits (also setMinimumTokenCost, setGasFeesPaidBy, setShieldedPayment) | `P:wasm-dpp2/src/state_transitions/batch/token_payment_info.rs` | — |

| `DataContract.getDocumentSchema (wasm-dpp)` | wasm-dpp legacy: JSON Schema of a document type (also setDocumentSchemas, getSchemaDefs, hasDocumentType) | `P:wasm-dpp/src/data_contract/data_contract.rs` | — |
| `DataContract.getTokenConfiguration (wasm-dpp)` | wasm-dpp legacy: TokenConfiguration for a token position | `P:wasm-dpp/src/data_contract/data_contract.rs` | — |

| `buildDataContractJson` | TS: build the `DataContractJSON` (`$formatVersion: '1'`, camelCase) from a source contract; normalizes config (`$formatVersion: '0'`) and token positions; passes through keywords/description/groups | `D:src/platform/contract.ts` | — |
| `publishContract` | TS: publish a contract via `@dashevo/evo-sdk` (`DataContract.fromJSON` + `sdk.contracts.publish`) with retry; returns `{ contractId }` | `D:src/platform/contract.ts` | — |
| `extractDocumentSchemas` | TS: extract document schemas from contract JSON (handles `documentSchemas` key and document-only format) | `D:src/platform/contract.ts` | — |

## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `$formatVersion` | Tag on the 5.0 JSON/serde wire form of a contract (`"1"` = DataContractInSerializationFormatV1) and nested config/token configs (`"0"`); older sources use `$format_version` | `{ "$formatVersion": "1", "id": "<base58>", "ownerId": "<base58>", "version": 1, "documentSchemas": { ... } }` |
| `documentSchemas` | Top-level contract key holding all document type schemas (name -> JSON Schema) | `{ "documentSchemas": { "note": { "type": "object", "properties": { ... }, "additionalProperties": false } } }` |
| `documents` | Legacy top-level key for document schemas (yappr-era JSON); evo-sdk wants `documentSchemas` | `{ "documents": { "profile": { "type": "object" } } }` |
| `schemaDefs` | Contract-level `$defs` shared by all document types (legacy alias `definitions`) | `"schemaDefs": { "identifier": { "type": "array", "byteArray": true, "minItems": 32, "maxItems": 32, "contentMediaType": "application/x.dash.dpp.identifier" } }` |
| `config` | Contract config object (DataContractConfig): canBeDeleted, readonly, keepsHistory, documentsKeepHistoryContractDefault, documentsMutableContractDefault, documentsCanBeDeletedContractDefault, requiresIdentity{En,De}cryptionBoundedKey, sizedIntegerTypes, moderation | `"config": { "$formatVersion": "0", "keepsHistory": false, "documentsMutableContractDefault": true }` |
| `sizedIntegerTypes` | Config flag enabling `u8/u16/u32/i8/i16/i32`-style sized integer property types | `"config": { "sizedIntegerTypes": true }` |
| `moderation` | Config V2 (protocol 14): contract moderation declaration with banlist, suspensions, warnings and moderators | `"config": { "moderation": { "banlist": true, "suspensions": true, "warnings": true, "moderators": { "$type": "contractOwner" } } }` |
| `keywords` | V1 contract search keywords (max 50 unique strings, indexed by keyword-search contract) | `"keywords": ["social", "messaging", "dash"]` |
| `description` | V1 contract description string (also `description` on token config) | `"description": "Social network contract"` |
| `groups` | V1 map of group position -> Group (members map + requiredPower) | `"groups": { "0": { "members": { "<id1>": 1, "<id2>": 1 }, "requiredPower": 2 } }` |
| `tokens` | V1 map of token position -> TokenConfiguration (camelCase fields, `$formatVersion`) | `"tokens": { "0": { "$formatVersion": "0", "conventions": { "$formatVersion": "0", "decimals": 8, "localizations": { "en": { "$formatVersion": "0", "shouldCapitalize": true, "singularForm": "coin", "pluralForm": "coins" } } }, "baseSupply": 100000 } }` |
| `AuthorizedActionTakers JSON` | 5.0 tagged form `{ "$type": ... }`: noOne / contractOwner / identity (+identity) / mainGroup / group (+position); old bare strings are rejected | `{ "$type": "contractOwner" }`, `{ "$type": "group", "position": 0 }`, `{ "$type": "identity", "identity": "<base58>" }` |
| `ChangeControlRules JSON` | Rule object: authorizedToMakeChange, adminActionTakers, changingAuthorizedActionTakersToNoOneAllowed, changingAdminActionTakersToNoOneAllowed, selfChangingAdminActionTakersAllowed | `{ "$formatVersion": "0", "authorizedToMakeChange": { "$type": "contractOwner" }, "adminActionTakers": { "$type": "noOne" }, "changingAuthorizedActionTakersToNoOneAllowed": false, "changingAdminActionTakersToNoOneAllowed": false, "selfChangingAdminActionTakersAllowed": false }` |
| `manualMintingRules` | Token config key: who may mint (ChangeControlRules); siblings manualBurningRules, freezeRules, unfreezeRules, destroyFrozenFundsRules, emergencyActionRules | `"manualMintingRules": { "authorizedToMakeChange": { "$type": "contractOwner" }, ... }` |
| `mainControlGroup` | Token config key: group position used by `mainGroup` action takers (+ mainControlGroupCanBeModified) | `"mainControlGroup": 0` |
| `baseSupply / maxSupply` | Token config supply keys (token amounts, integers); maxSupply optional | `"baseSupply": 100000, "maxSupply": 1000000` |
| `distributionRules` | Token config: perpetualDistribution, preProgrammedDistribution, newTokensDestinationIdentity, mintingAllowChoosingDestination (+ *Rules); V1 adds once-per-identity distribution | `"distributionRules": { "$formatVersion": "1", "perpetualDistribution": { ... } }` |
| `keepsHistory (token)` | Token config key with keepsTransferHistory, keepsFreezingHistory, keepsMintingHistory, keepsBurningHistory, keepsDirectPricingHistory, keepsDirectPurchaseHistory flags | `"keepsHistory": { "$formatVersion": "0", "keepsTransferHistory": true, ... }` |
| `marketplaceRules` | Token config: tradeMode (`NotTradeable`) + tradeModeChangeRules | `"marketplaceRules": { "$formatVersion": "0", "tradeMode": "NotTradeable", ... }` |
| `startAsPaused` | Token config: token starts paused until an emergency-action Resume | `"startAsPaused": true` |
| `Token config preset` | TokenConfigurationPreset JSON: features enum + actionTaker | `{ "features": "WithMintingAndBurningActions", "actionTaker": { "$type": "group", "position": 0 } }` |
| `Group JSON` | Group with two members of power 1 requiring power 2 (both must sign) | `{ "$formatVersion": "0", "members": { "<id1>": 1, "<id2>": 1 }, "requiredPower": 2 }` |
| `indices` | Array of Index definitions in a document schema (max 10 properties each, `asc` only) | `"indices": [{ "name": "ownerIdx", "properties": [{ "$ownerId": "asc" }], "unique": false }]` |
| `unique` | Index flag: enforce uniqueness of the property tuple | `{ "name": "byName", "properties": [{ "name": "asc" }], "unique": true }` |
| `nullSearchable` | Index flag: allow searching documents whose indexed properties are null/absent | `"nullSearchable": false` |
| `contested` | Index object resolved by masternode vote (DPNS usernames): fieldMatches [{field, regexPattern}], resolution (0 = MasternodeVote), description | `"contested": { "fieldMatches": [{ "field": "normalizedLabel", "regexPattern": "^[a-zA-Z01]{3,19}$" }], "resolution": 0, "description": "..." }` |
| `countable / rangeCountable` | Index (and doctype) count trees: `countable` is bool or `notCountable`/`countable`/`countableAllowingOffset`; rangeCountable adds range counts | `{ "name": "byTag", "properties": [{ "tag": "asc" }], "countable": "countable" }` |
| `summable / averageable` | Index/doctype aggregation: `summable: "<intProp>"` sums an integer property; `averageable` = countable + summable; ranged variants `rangeSummable`, `rangeAverageable` | `"documentsSummable": "amount"` |
| `rankedCountable / rankedSummable / rankedAverageable` | Index flags adding ordered ranking trees (top/bottom-K queries) | `"rankedCountable": true` |
| `timeRange` | Index bucketing a leading `$createdAt/$updatedAt/$transferredAt` property into time windows (on, range, step, phase, ttl) | `"timeRange": { "on": "$createdAt", "range": 3600, "step": 3600 }` |
| `integerRange` | Index bucketing a leading required integer property into windows (on, range, step, phase) | `"integerRange": { "on": "score", "range": 100, "step": 100 }` |
| `indexOnly / terminal / entryPayload` | Doctype stored only in index entries: `indexOnly: true`, index `terminal` property/list, doctype `entryPayload` value fields | `"indexOnly": true` |
| `preallocated / outlivesDelete / skipIfAbsent / summableOffCountIndex` | Advanced index keys for indexOnly types (preallocated paths, entries surviving delete, conditional participation, sum of another index's counts) | `{ "name": "i", "properties": [{ "a": "asc" }], "skipIfAbsent": ["a"] }` |
| `documentsKeepHistory` | Doctype flag storing every document revision | `"documentsKeepHistory": true` |
| `keepsTransferHistory / keepsPurchaseHistory / keepsPricingHistory` | Doctype flags recording transfers/purchases/price updates in the document-history system contract | `"keepsTransferHistory": true` |
| `documentsMutable` | Doctype flag allowing replace after creation (default true) | `"documentsMutable": false` |
| `canBeDeleted` | Doctype: true / false / `"onlyWhenConsumed"` (deleted only by a create whose refersTo declares consume) | `"canBeDeleted": true` |
| `transferable` | Doctype: 0 = Never, 1 = Always | `"transferable": 1` |
| `tradeMode` | Doctype: 0 = None, 1 = DirectPurchase | `"tradeMode": 1` |
| `creationRestrictionMode` | Doctype: 0 = no restrictions, 1 = owner only, 2 = no creation (system only) | `"creationRestrictionMode": 1` |
| `signatureSecurityLevelRequirement` | Doctype minimum signing key level: 1 = critical, 2 = high (default), 3 = medium (master 0 not allowed) | `"signatureSecurityLevelRequirement": 3` |
| `requiresIdentityEncryptionBoundedKey / requiresIdentityDecryptionBoundedKey` | Doctype StorageKeyRequirements: 0 = Unique, 1 = Multiple, 2 = MultipleReferenceToLatest | `"requiresIdentityEncryptionBoundedKey": 2` |
| `tokenCost` | Doctype per-action token cost (create/replace/delete/transfer/update_price/purchase): contractId, tokenPosition, amount, effect, gasFeesPaidBy, optional | `"tokenCost": { "create": { "tokenPosition": 0, "amount": 10, "effect": 0, "gasFeesPaidBy": 0 } }` |
| `actionFees` | Doctype fixed credit fees per action split owner/moderators pots (claimed via ContractFeeClaim) | `"actionFees": { "create": { "owner": 1000, "moderators": 500 } }` |
| `moderatorAbilities` | Doctype: moderators may `delete`, `deleteSettled`, `changeFields` on documents of this type | `"moderatorAbilities": { "delete": true }` |
| `ttl` | Doctype time-to-live in seconds after `$createdAt`; platform deletes expired documents | `"ttl": 86400` |
| `transient` | Top-level property names validated but never stored | `"transient": ["nonce"]` |
| `immutable` | Doctype property names a replace may not change (entries may be `{property, when}`) | `"immutable": ["title"]` |
| `retractedWhen` | Doctype condition letting a barred owner write one retracting replace | `"retractedWhen": { "equal": ["status", { "const": "retracted" }] }` |
| `propertyConstraints / deleteConstraints` | Named rules every created/replaced (or deleted) document must meet (compare, in, startsWith, countOf, sumOf, $old reads) | `"propertyConstraints": { "positiveAmount": { "greaterThan": ["amount", 0] } }` |
| `ownerRefersTo / creatorRefersTo` | Doctype refersTo declarations for `$ownerId` / `$creatorId` | `"ownerRefersTo": { "type": "identity" }` |
| `refersTo` | Property: typed reference (identity, contract, token, permanentDocument, deletableDocument, moderatedDocument, identityPublicKey) or `anyOf`/`allOf` expression | `"refersTo": { "type": "permanentDocument", "contractId": "<base58>", "documentType": "profile" }` |
| `encryptedFor` | Byte-array property: recipient, recipientKey, senderKey, scheme (`ecdh-secp256k1-aes256-cbc`) | `"encryptedFor": { "recipient": "$ownerId", "recipientKey": "keyId", "senderKey": "senderKeyId", "scheme": "ecdh-secp256k1-aes256-cbc" }` |
| `generatedFrom` | String property: platform-generated from other properties via `sys.` functions (string transformations, hashes) | `"generatedFrom": { "function": "sys.stringTransformations.lowercase", "params": ["label"] }` |
| `distinctFrom` | Identifier property: must differ from another property or `$ownerId` | `"distinctFrom": "$ownerId"` |
| `requiredSince` | Property: contract version since which the property is required (for updates adding required fields) | `"requiredSince": 2` |
| `maxBytes` | String property (or typed-array items): max UTF-8 bytes, 1..65535 | `"maxBytes": 256` |
| `byteArray` | Field modifier making a JSON `array` field a binary byte string | `{ "type": "array", "byteArray": true, "minItems": 32, "maxItems": 32 }` |
| `contentMediaType` | Binary field annotation; `application/x.dash.dpp.identifier` marks an Identifier | `"contentMediaType": "application/x.dash.dpp.identifier"` |
| `position` | Required per-property integer fixing deterministic serialization order | `"position": 0` |
| `additionalProperties` | Must be `false` in every document type schema (and nested object) | `"additionalProperties": false` |
| `typed array` | `type: "array"` with `items` naming the element type (integers, strings, identifiers) plus minItems/maxItems/uniqueItems | `{ "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 32 }, "maxItems": 10, "position": 3 }` |
| `$defs` | Shared subschemas reused via `$ref` | `"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"` |
| `$schema (legacy)` | Legacy contract schema URL; not required in the 5.0 format | `"$schema": "https://schema.dash.org/dpp-0-4-0/meta/data-contract"` |
| `$ownerId / $createdAt / $updatedAt / $transferredAt` | System document fields usable in indices and constraints (also `$id`, `$revision`, `$creatorId`, block-height/core-height variants) | `{ "name": "recent", "properties": [{ "$createdAt": "asc" }] }` |
